shortDescription: Manage a host group (cascaded initiator group) on a PowerMax/VMAX storage system

options.name: host_flags
options.description: input as an yaml dictionary. List of all host_flags - 1. volume_set_addressing. 2. disable_q_reset_on_ua. 3. environ_set. 4. avoid_reset_broadcast. 5. openvms. 6. scsi_3. 7. spc2_protocol_version. 8. scsi_support1. 9. consistent_lun. Possible values are true, false, unset(default state).

options.name: host_state
options.description: Define whether the host should be present or absent in the host group. present-in-group - indicates that the hosts should exist in the host group. absent-in-group - indicates that the hosts should not exist in the host group.

options.name: host_type
options.description: Describing the OS type (default or hpux).

options.name: hostgroup_name
options.description: The name of the host group. No Special Character support except for _. Case sensitive for REST Calls.

options.name: hosts
options.description: List of host names to be added to the host group or removed from the host group. Creation of an empty host group is allowed.

options.name: new_name
options.description: The new name for the host group for the renaming function. No Special Character support except for _. Case sensitive for REST Calls.

options.name: password
options.description: The password of the Unisphere host.

options.name: port
options.description: The port of the Unisphere host.

options.name: serial_no
options.description: The serial number of the PowerMax/VMAX array. It is a required parameter for all array-specific operations except for getting a list of arrays in the Gatherfacts module.

options.name: state
options.description: Define whether the host group should be present or absent on the system. present - indicates that the host group should be present on the system. absent - indicates that the host group should be absent on the system.

options.name: timeout
options.description: Time after which the connection will get terminated. It is to be mentioned in seconds.

options.name: unispherehost
options.description: IP or FQDN of the Unisphere host

options.name: user
options.description: The username of the Unisphere host.

options.name: verifycert
options.description: Specifies system whether to validate SSL certificate or not, Values can be True or False or a custom file path for SSL certificate with .pem extension or .cer with base 64 encoding.
